title: SceneAxi CLI command-to-held-key map (v1)
description: Declares, per CLI verb, which captain decision keys gate it. Ships with the CLI and versions with the protocol envelope. A verb whose behavior depends on a held key MUST list it here; verbs composed of other verbs MUST list the union (dependency closure). Enforcement semantics: docs/held-key-enforcement.md.

builtForRegistryEpoch.description: The held-key registry epoch this map was authored against. Snapshot epoch mismatch at runtime → refusal.

command.description: Full verb path, e.g. 'project new' or 'catalog list'.

heldKeys.description: Every decision key whose openness must refuse this verb. Empty array is an explicit declaration that the verb is ungated — absence of a command from this map is NOT.

composedOf.description: Verbs this verb composes; its heldKeys must be a superset of theirs (checked in CI).
